tweets: Chandragupta Maurya, guided by the strategist Chanakya, overthrew the Nanda dynasty around 321 BCE, founding Bhārata's first pan-Indian empire, stretching from the Hindu Kush to the Bay of Bengal.

In 305 BCE he met Seleucus I Nicator in battle. Peace brought a marriage alliance and 500 war elephants for frontier lands, plus the envoy Megasthenes, whose Indica remains a rare eyewitness account of Mauryan India. Follow @yddoseOfHistory for your daily dose of history
